chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Many an expression is more effective than an attack.

key_terms.أَنْفَذُ: more effective, more piercing, more decisive

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'rubb qawlin anfadhu min sawlin' mean in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) contrasts the enduring impact of articulate wisdom with the transient nature of brute force, a concept deeply rooted in the Shia understanding of *Hikmah* (wisdom) as a primary tool of governance. This saying underscores the strategic superiority of verbal persuasion and eloquence (*Balagha*) in resolving conflicts and influencing hearts, reflecting the Prophet's tradition of using speech as a decisive weapon. It serves as a practical guideline for leaders to prioritize intellectual and rhetorical power over physical coercion.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 394. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
Many an expression is more effective than an attack.
